parts.speak: Three riddles. Three clues each. Ten seconds to solve each one. Get all three, and your brain is officially warmed up.
parts.subtitle: 3 riddles · 3 clues · 10 seconds each
parts.title: RIDDLE CHALLENGE

parts.display: Clue 1: I repeat everything you say, but I have no mouth of my own.
parts.speak: Riddle one. Clue one: I repeat everything you say, but I have no mouth of my own.

parts.display: Clue 2: You can hear me, but you can never see me.
parts.speak: Clue two: you can hear me, but you can never see me.

parts.display: Clue 3: The louder you shout, the louder I answer.
parts.speak: Clue three: the louder you shout, the louder I answer. Ten seconds, go.
An echo. Sound bouncing back to you.

parts.display: Clue 1: I follow you everywhere in daylight.
parts.speak: Riddle two. Clue one: I follow you everywhere in daylight.

parts.display: Clue 2: I copy your every move, but I never make a sound.
parts.speak: Clue two: I copy your every move, but I never make a sound.

parts.display: Clue 3: You can never touch me, but I am always right behind you.
parts.speak: Clue three: you can never touch me, but I am always right behind you. Ten seconds, go.
Your shadow. It follows you, but it never makes a sound.

parts.display: Clue 1: The more I dry you, the wetter I become.
parts.speak: Riddle three. Clue one: the more I dry you, the wetter I become.

parts.display: Clue 2: I hang on a hook and wait for your shower.
parts.speak: Clue two: I hang on a hook and wait for your shower.

parts.display: Clue 3: I soak it all up, then I need to dry out myself.
parts.speak: Clue three: I soak it all up, then I need to dry out myself. Ten seconds, go.

parts.explain: The more it dries you, the wetter it gets.
parts.speak: A towel. The more it dries you, the wetter it gets.
How many did you solve? Tell me your score in the comments, and send this to a friend who thinks they are clever.
parts.subtitle: Comment your score · Challenge a friend
parts.title: HOW MANY DID YOU SOLVE?

note: All three riddles are original wording written for this video. The answers (echo, shadow, towel) are classic public-domain riddle concepts; no copyrighted text is used.
